text: Maybe put up a cup of coffee or tea Put on a record, watch a movie, maybe cook up a meal For my echo, my shadow in me But alone here I sit, not too blue, just a bit Maybe I'll sit at the piano and play It always sounds better in inclement weather And I'm all alone when it rains
